project.name: TILDA - Bicycle Parking
project.description: TILDA processes bicycle parking facilities from OpenStreetMap data to analyze parking capacity, type, and accessibility.

tags.description: Selects bicycle parking features for this topic.
Total capacity; normalized together with `capacity:*` sub-keys when present.
Who may use the parking (e.g. yes, private, permissive, customers).
Whether parking is covered (yes, no, partial).
Whether use of the parking is subject to a fee.
Whether the location is lit (yes or no).
Whether cargo bicycles are explicitly accommodated.
Physical form of the parking (stands, shed, lockers, two-tier, …).
Related traffic sign reference, normalized in processing.
Whether the operator is classified as public or private.
